info.title: MetaEngine.CSharp.Protobuf.HttpClient.Tool
info.description: Command-line dotnet tool that generates idiomatic C# gRPC-Connect clients and models from Protobuf (.proto) definitions — HttpClient-based services with System.Text.Json models, or binary gRPC clients via Grpc.Net.Client + protobuf-net. Wraps the MetaEngine.CSharp.Protobuf.HttpClient engine.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate C# gRPC-Connect HttpClient services and models from Protobuf (.proto) definitions

options.name: --documentation
options.description: Generate XML doc comments from proto comments [default: False]

options.name: --validation-annotations
options.description: Emit System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations attributes on models from protovalidate (buf.validate) constraints [default: False]

options.name: --bearer-auth
options.description: Bearer token from env var (default API_TOKEN). Adds an Authorization header to all requests.

options.name: --basic-auth
options.description: Basic auth from env vars (API_USERNAME / API_PASSWORD). [default: False]

options.name: --retries
options.description: Enable retries with exponential backoff. Optional value sets max attempts.

options.name: --custom-header
options.description: Static header from env var. Repeatable. Format: <header-name>=<env-var-name> (e.g. X-Tenant-ID=TENANT_ID)

options.name: --grpc-binary
options.description: Generate binary gRPC clients (Grpc.Net.Client + protobuf-net) instead of Connect-RPC JSON over HttpClient. [default: False]

options.name: --dependency-injection
options.description: Generate IServiceCollection extension methods for DI registration of typed HttpClients. [default: False]

options.name: --type-mapping
options.description: Override a protobuf well-known type mapping. Repeatable. Format: <protobuf.Type>=<FullyQualifiedDotNetType> (e.g. google.protobuf.Timestamp=System.DateTime)

options.name: --include-types
options.description: Only generate these proto types (comma-separated message/enum names)

options.name: --clean
options.description: Clean the destination directory before generating [default: False]

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Protobuf (.proto) file path or inline proto content

arguments.name: OUTPUT
arguments.description: Output directory for generated C# files

arguments.name: NAMESPACE
arguments.description: Root namespace for the generated client and models
